messages:
Marta K: Hey infra team — onboarding Ember (account 123456789012) into ap-northeast-8 (apne8). We need accelerator + network entitlements before pilot next week. p5 + g5 primarily, ENI bump, and IPv6 fallback. Any blockers? :eyes:
Samir: Thanks — can you confirm numbers you want us to request from AWS? They sometimes ask for entitlement docs for p5/p4d.
Leo: Also callout that apne8 has limited NATGW / EIP pools for our accounts historically. Need to plan EIP or IPv6 fallback.
Marta K: Quick confirm: p5=8, g5=16, p4d=2 (safety), ENI per AZ=200, Elastic IPs=20. Timeline: need approval by 2024-08-01 for pilot.
Samir: I'll draft the AWS Support case and open with Business Support. Draft below, please review:```Subject: Request GPU accelerator entitlements and network limits for account 123456789012 in ap-northeast-8

Details:
- Account ID: 123456789012
- Region: ap-northeast-8 (apne8)
- Requested accelerator entitlements: p5 -> 8, g5 -> 16, p4d -> 2
- ENI quota: increase to 200 per AZ
- Elastic IPs: 20
- IPv6: enable VPC IPv6 and request fallback pool for NAT-less workloads
- Reason: Dedicated tenant (Ember) pilot then reserved capacity; predictable throughput required
- Timeline: needed by 2024-08-01
- Attachments: tenant commitment letter (will attach), cost owner and SRE point of contact
```
Samir: If AWS asks for utilization plan, say steady-state ~6 concurrent p5 nodes for inference, bursts up to 8; KV/cache residency requires low-latency in-region.
Leo: Also include request to whitelist ENI allocations for our account family (org ID 987654321098) — that helps multi-account placement and ip exhaustion workarounds.
Marta K: Added: org ID 987654321098 and point contacts: Marta K (marta@example.com), Ops Pager: +1-555-0102.
infra-bot: Noted. Opening support case now (case# 123456-APNE8-GPU). Will attach the draft and ping AWS TAM. :rocket:
Samir: AWS may come back asking for expected spend or commitment; @finance please prepare a short spend projection (monthly GPU-hours) — Mateo / Finance, can you join?
Marta K: looping in finance separately, will post the spend projection once I have numbers.
CI-bot: reminder: create a capacity playbook entry after entitlement is approved — template: `docs/onboardings/apne8-ember.md`.
Leo: One other note — subnet sizing: we should reserve /26 per AZ for node bootstrap to avoid ENI fragmentation. Add that to the ticket body.
Samir: Updated ticket body and uploaded subnet plan diagram. AWS replied: "We need justification for p5 entitlement; please provide expected vCPU count and memory footprint per instance."
Marta K: Reply text suggestion: "Each p5 will run our inference runtime with 640 vCPU-equivalent threads (host-side accounting), 4-6TB persistent model KV per node, average life 72h per node. Usage will be steady-state for inference; peak bursts controlled via our scheduler."
Samir: Sent that. AWS replied that they approved preliminary ENI/EIP increases but escalated accelerator entitlements to service team for manual review — ETA 2 business days.
Marta K: Great. If accelerator entitlement is delayed, what's fallback? Leo?
Leo: Fallback: route traffic to eu-west-2 dedicated pool (higher latency) or spin smaller g5 fleet in apne1 for immediate capacity. Both increase cost but keep pilot on schedule.
Marta K: Ok plan B noted. Thanks all — keep this thread updated when case# 123456-APNE8-GPU changes status. :thumbsup:
